title: Undoing a chat turn asks first inside the card, runs one undo at a time per chat, reads the chat fresh before offering Undo, counts only a verified undo as done, and keeps undos of unknown outcome apart from refusals
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: node --test --test-timeout=30000 packages/ui/tracy-chat-input/test/turn-undo-card.test.mjs packages/ui/tracy-chat-input/test/turn-undo.test.mjs packages/ui/tracy-chat-input/test/turn-card.test.mjs apps/tracy-web/test/turn-undo.test.mjs
S2: Read the pass/fail counts and the tests named below.
expect: 'Cancel sends nothing and goes back to the card' passes: 0 POSTs to /api/sites/<key>/turns/undo.
'Undo asks inside the card, sends one POST for the latest turn, re-reads, reloads the preview, then shows Undone' passes.
'in flight: a second confirm starts no second POST, and no other card of the chat can start an undo' passes: exactly one POST.
'a card shown for another chat, or back to one, draws no Undo until a fresh read of that chat answered' passes.
'outcomes: done, partial, refused with its code, and every kind of silence as unsure' passes: a 2xx that is not a turns-undo answer, a 5xx with no answer and a thrown fetch are unsure, never refused.
'a refusal leaves a line and reloads no preview' passes.

In apps/tracy-web/test/turn-undo.test.mjs every test passes, including the ones on revertOutcome (only {ok: true} from apply.revert is a revert; COMPONENT_UNREACHABLE and COMPONENT_BAD_RESPONSE are unsure) and on runUndo stopping at the first step that did not verifiably succeed.

selectors.function: packages/ui/tracy-chat-input/src/client/turn-undo.mjs undoTurn, createTurnsBook; apps/tracy-web/src/sites/turn-undo.js revertOutcome, fileOutcome, runUndo

evidence: Issue #802: one press on Undo all sent one apply.revert per change with no question, and refusals were shown as a count only; a 200 with an unreadable body counted as reverted. Since feat/undo-turn-card (06/10/2026) the per-turn card replaces the Undo all card and the reverts run on the server; this case keeps the same fences on the new path.
fence: The card's confirm gate and per-chat in-flight guard, the fresh read required after a change of chat, the client's outcome rule (done / partial / refused / unsure), and the server's rule that only {ok: true} from apply.revert and a verified restore commit count as undone. Mounted with fixtures for fetch: no live site.

tests: Cancel sends nothing and goes back to the card
Undo asks inside the card, sends one POST for the latest turn
in flight: a second confirm starts no second POST
a card shown for another chat, or back to one, draws no Undo until a fresh read
outcomes: done, partial, refused with its code, and every kind of silence as unsure
a refusal leaves a line and reloads no preview
